description.plain:
Meet your new everyday carry. Handcrafted from premium full-grain buffalo leather, The brown Portland tote bag gets richer and more beautiful with every use, each bag developing its own unique patina over time. Designed to keep up with your day, it features a top zip closure and an exterior zip pocket for quick access to your essentials. Inside, a cotton-lined interior with a dedicated laptop sleeve and slip pockets keeps everything right where you need it. Carry it with the sturdy leather top handles or switch to the removable, adjustable shoulder strap for hands-free ease.

Sizes & Dimension

  • Small 13" (L) Top, 10" (L) Bottom × 11.5" (H) × 4.5" (W)
  • Large 17" (L) Top, 12" (L) Bottom × 13" (H) × 6" (W)
  • Oversized 21" (L) Top, 13.5" (L) Bottom × 13" (H) × 6" (W)

Care Instructions

  • Cleaning: Wipe gently with a soft, damp cloth and a mild cleaning solution never soak or machine wash
  • Storage: Keep in a well-ventilated area or a breathable cloth bag; avoid plastic bags for extended periods
  • Moisture Control: During humid months, if any moisture appears, clean lightly with a soft cloth dampened with a mild antiseptic solution
  • Conditioning: When leather looks dry, apply a small amount of leather cream or conditioner and buff gently to restore softness and shine
  • Avoid: Prolonged exposure to direct sunlight, heat sources, or harsh chemicals

Embossing location: Along the top, opposite side of the WILL logo

 

Inspired by vintage utility carryalls, the Workshop Tote is a full-grain leather tote made for everyday life. Its clean, understated shape is crafted from glossy pebbled leather that brings natural texture and character to a lightweight, easy-carry design.

 

Two sewn-in tubular leather handles are long enough to carry comfortably by hand or over the shoulder, while a magnetic snap closure keeps the spacious interior secure without slowing you down. Inside, the unlined construction keeps the bag light and lets the leather speak for itself, with a large slip pocket providing easy access to the essentials you reach for most.

 

Built to move easily between workdays, errands, travel, and weekends, this versatile leather shoulder tote is designed to wear beautifully and gain character with time. Antique brass hardware and heavy-gauge, dyed-to-match nylon stitching add lasting strength without taking away from its simple silhouette.

 

Add complimentary embossing for a personal finishing touch. Like every WILL Leather Goods piece, the Workshop Tote is backed by our Lifetime Guarantee—made to be carried often and lived with for years to come.
